scope: classical finite relational first-order 0-1 law structural mathematics

model.random_space: independent Bernoulli(1/2) truth assignment for each relation tuple over [n]
model.probability_normalization: total mass over finite model space equals 1

extension_axiom_surface.almost_sure_bound: Pr[A_n does not satisfy EA_tau] <= n^m * (1 - 2^(-N_tau))^(n-m)

completion_chain: individual extension axioms are almost sure
finite subsets of T_ext are almost sure by union bound
T_ext completeness is supplied by countable back-and-forth
finite proof extraction supplies finite Gamma subset of T_ext
syntactic soundness gives event carrier inclusions
probability monotonicity and complement bounds force limit 0 or 1
final_theorem_surface: For every first-order sentence phi over a finite positive-arity relational vocabulary L, lim_n Pr[A_n |= phi] is in {0,1}.
boundaries: no Lean-formal Fagin theorem closure claim
no repository-level global finite-model-theory closure claim
no 0-1 law claim for 0-ary relation symbols
